question: Guru Nileshwar Mukharjee is the exponent of which of the following Indian classical dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __Manipuri__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] Key Points__

__
 
• Guru Nileshwar Mukharjee

 
 
• ​Guru Nileshwar Mukharjee is a well-known Manipuri dancer from India who has achieved international fame.
 
• The Manipuri community is well aware of Guru Nileshwar Mukharjee, who has made significant contributions to the field of Manipuri dance. Guru Nileshwar Mukharjee gave a Ras performance in Sylhet in 1920, and Rabindranath Tagore was so moved that he summoned him to Shantiniketan.
 
• In the history of Manipuri dance, this event marked a turning point. Within a decade, it had transcended national boundaries and made Guru Nileshwar Mukharjee's name well-known around the world.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

 
• Manipuri Dance

 
 
• One of the eight principal Indian classical dance styles, the Manipuri Dance is also known as the Manipuri Raas Leela (Meitei: Jagoi Raas, Raas Jagoi) and is a product of the state of Manipur.
 
• The dancing style is characterised by delicate, calm body motions and compassionate gaze, and it is infused with the spiritual themes of Madhura Raas of Radha-Krishna.
 
• Whether a dancer is Hindu or not, their expressions are generally calm and convey Bhakti Rasa, or the emotion of devotion.
